discoveries.title: How these markets actually settle
discoveries.body: Measured before launch on 200 resolved markets: comparing Chainlink's 60-second TWAP at the close with the 60-second TWAP at the open reproduced Polymarket's official result 99% of the time (using Binance as a stand-in), while the open/close numbers from Polymarket's crypto-price endpoint matched only 88.5%. So the AI computes the price to beat itself and settles trades only on the official resolution.

discoveries.title: Settlement rule check
discoveries.body: The AI's own rule (60-second Chainlink TWAP at the close vs at the open) matched Polymarket's official result in 931 of 983 markets (94.7%). Mismatches happened only when the margin was tiny (median 2.00 bp).

discoveries.title: Trades are over-confident
discoveries.body: Across 325 settled trades the model's average confidence was 67% but it won 58%. Calibration needs work.

discoveries.title: UP/DOWN base rate
discoveries.body: UP won 48.2% of the last 1223 markets - consistent with 50/50 (±2.9%).

discoveries.title: Model accuracy vs the market
discoveries.body: The market price is more accurate than the champion model (0.0012 Brier gap over 1152 markets). Edges are hard to find; the AI should stay selective.

discoveries.title: The market beats the fair-value model
discoveries.body: Over 60 markets the market price was more accurate than S024's model (its log loss was 0.010 worse per market, and still worse at the edge of the 95% confidence range). Trading against a more accurate market loses money, so real paper trades stop. All strategies keep trading virtually; the first one to show a statistically significant profit takes over.

discoveries.title: What moves these markets
discoveries.body: Signals that point the right way most often (measured on 1242 markets): 3-minute momentum at 150s right 81% of the time (n=713, the market price itself was right 81%); 3-minute momentum at 90s right 75% of the time (n=875, the market price itself was right 77%); 1-minute momentum at 30s right 71% of the time (n=920, the market price itself was right 72%). Pointing the right way is not enough to profit: it also has to beat the price you pay.

discoveries.title: No tradable pattern yet
discoveries.body: Tested 64 signal/time combinations on 1242 markets. None beats the market price by enough to cover fees yet. Closest: 1-minute momentum at 30s (+3.0 points vs the price, n=920). The AI keeps collecting data.
